# Whoami

`schemas/api/whoami.json`

The authenticated caller, GET /v1/whoami (docs/design/m0/14 "Read scope"): its actor, the token it presented (its id, never its hash), the listener it came through and its effective read scope. Not a grant domain: every authenticated caller may read its own.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor` | yes | [ActorID](common-defs.md#actorid) |  |
| `kind` | yes | one of `operator`, `supervisor` |  |
| `token` | yes | [TokenID](common-defs.md#tokenid) |  |
| `listener` | yes | one of `private_socket`, `shared_socket`, `https` |  |
| `reads` | yes | object ([fields](#fields-of-reads)) | everything: an operator reads every record; otherwise the read reach of each grant in force, by grant. |

No other fields are allowed.
